clips.title: The story
paras: At Mor'shan Base Camp, Kelm Hargunth keeps the Warsong Outriders supplied. He equips Horde champions fighting night elves in Warsong Gulch with care packages and provisions.

At Mor'shan Base Camp, Kelm Hargunth manages supplies for the Warsong Outriders. The camp stands on the northern edge of the Barrens, beside the border with Ashenvale. Scouts and raiders skirmish beyond its stockade while Kelm sees that weapons, armor, and rations reach the fighters. The Warsong Outriders face the Silverwing Sentinels, and a steady flow of provisions matters as much as fury in battle.

Kelm gives specialized supplies to warriors who have proven themselves in Warsong Gulch. His stores include care packages with field dressings and iron rations, along with armaments marked with the Warsong clan's crimson insignia. These supplies go to fighters serving the Horde's campaign in the forests to the north.
